name: Wren

triggers.cue: Someone has just come by. Pass on one piece of news they haven't heard (TELL), in a sentence or two, the way neighbours gossip. Pick the freshest.

cue: Reply to the customer's last words. If they ask what's new, pass on something you know (TELL).

fallbacks.rejected: Wait, wait, I'll get it right. Ask me again?
fallbacks.unavailable: Can't stop, the washing's on the line!
